# StudyAI MK3

Local-first study workspace with courses, lessons, a scientific canvas, document search, adaptive review, and an AI tutor.

- Scientific canvas: draw, diagram, annotate and reason over scientific objects.
- Document library: import PDFs and search indexed course material.
- Tutor: ask grounded questions about the active lesson and canvas.

- [StudyAI home](http://127.0.0.1:5183/)
- [Agentic resource manifest](http://127.0.0.1:5183/.well-known/ard.json)
- [CopilotKit runtime info](http://127.0.0.1:5183/api/copilotkit/info)

This is a local development application served on http://127.0.0.1:5183/.
